description: This file contains internal helper classes and methods for error messaging within the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including exception generators and message strings.

classes.name: MSG
classes.description: Static class providing message strings and exception generators for internal use.

methods.name: SomeMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with provided parameters.

methods.name: ArgumentException_StyleExpected
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating a style type was expected.

methods.name: ArgumentException_UndefinedBaseStyle
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating a base style is undefined.

methods.name: InvalidDocumentObjectType
methods.description: Returns an error message for invalid document object types.

methods.name: DdlParserException_NewlineInString
methods.description: Creates an exception for a newline inside a string literal.

methods.name: DdlParserException_EscapeSequenceNotAllowed
methods.description: Creates an exception for an illegal escape sequence.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_MergeDownTooLarge
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a table cell's MergeDown exceeds table bounds.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_MergeRightTooLarge
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a table cell's MergeRight exceeds table bounds.
